entries.reason: The tests read and set a process environment variable here and nowhere else. The test project has no other way to switch the benchmark, baseline-update and example-data modes, or to point the app settings store at a test file.
entries.review: Added with the change that routes all test environment access through TestEnvironment. Tier A: the owner approves the permanent seam in that pull request.
